idea:
Review and improve the existing rebase process to make it more robust. The primary enhancement is to integrate a conflict resolution agent that automatically handles merge conflicts during rebase operations.

**Requirements:**
- Review the current rebase implementation
- Add automatic invocation of a 'rebase agent' when conflicts occur
- Use Claude Opus as the default agent for conflict resolution
- Ensure the process is robust and handles edge cases

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Current rebase process code has been reviewed
- [ ] Rebase agent integration is implemented
- [ ] Agent is triggered automatically when conflicts are detected
- [ ] Claude Opus is configured as the default rebase agent
- [ ] Process handles common conflict scenarios robustly
- [ ] Error handling for agent failures is in place
